content: The fourth level of light in the Mafāḥiṣ, section 4, is the letter: alone able to reveal things as they are in an absolute sense, it pertains solely to the revealed heavenly form, wholly unsusceptible to error from within or without. To it alone belongs the all-comprehensive sublimity that transcends all dichotomies, for every nature except the letter must occupy one of two opposed categories.
